lead.headline: Franz Wagner Backs Up 33 With 38 as Orlando Stacks Wins
lead.subhead: One night after snapping the Magic's skid with a season-high 33 in Sacramento, Wagner went bigger: 38 points and 8 boards in a 123-108 win at Utah. Two nights, two statements. Momentum isn't luck; it's the second night proving the first one wasn't a fluke.

articles.hed: Cousins Back in Purple, Ready to Start
articles.body: One day after the deadline deal, Kirk Cousins is expected to start right away for Minnesota in the offense he already knows. A familiar system and a fresh chance, the kind of second act every grinder recognizes.

articles.hed: Luka Drops 32 as the Lakers Go 11-2
articles.body: Luka Doncic poured in 32 in Milwaukee and the Lakers won 123-112, tied for the best start in the league. Steady wins, stacked one on top of another.

openingBell.title: The Opening Bell
openingBell.intro: Thursday, the day of Jupiter. Four counts in, four hold, four out, four hold. Jupiter is the king's planet: expansion, confidence, generosity, big asks. Breathe slow and think big.

breathing.title: Box Breathing — 4 · 4 · 4 · 4

phases.label: INHALE
phases.cue: Draw in through the nose — even, quiet, full.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Stillness at the top. No strain. Own the pause.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Empty and steady. Reset the line.

breathing.close: Four rounds squares the mind. Eyes open. Shoulders down. Body next. Then go take Thursday.

mindset.body: Franz Wagner dropped 33 one night and 38 the next. The first big night gets the headline; the second one builds the reputation. Yesterday's good call means nothing if today's dials are soft. Show up again, same intensity, and make the streak undeniable. Competitive. Unbeatable. Always rising. fall down 7 stand up 8.

bodyOpener.title: 3-Minute Opener
bodyOpener.note: Thursday, the day of Jupiter: run this right after Morning Charge. It's clear, dry and about 38° outside, so the RipStick finisher can go on the porch if you want the cold air. Big reps, big energy.

moves.name: Push-ups
moves.body: Crisp reps, chest to floor. If you hit 30 early, hold high plank until the minute mark.

moves.name: Plank
moves.body: Elbows or hands. Ribs down, glutes on. Breathe slow.

moves.name: RipStick finisher
moves.body: Dom's RipStick (RipRight): hold sticks at chest → inhale and pull apart as wide as possible → with bands open, exhale and push arms straight out while keeping them apart (dynamic isometrics / Push-Pulls). Smooth continuous reps for the remaining time.

Thursday belongs to Jupiter, the Greek Zeus: king of the gods, ruler of growth, honor and abundance. Old grimoires set it aside for workings of wealth, favor and leadership. Make the bigger ask today.

items.hed: Meister Eckhart and the ground of the soul
items.body: The 14th-century Dominican taught that there is a still place in the soul that nothing outside can touch. He preached it to working people, not just monks. Calm at the core is what lets you move fast on the surface.
This Valentinian text from Nag Hammadi says error grew from forgetting, and that knowing who you are dissolves it like fog at sunrise. Remembering your aim is half the work.

grimoire.title: Grimoire
grimoire.source: From the wisdom attributed to Solomon
grimoire.body: Solomon wrote: 'The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty only to want' (Proverbs 21:5). The rushed pitch leaves money on the table. Plan the call, then work the plan.
grimoire.practice: Before your first big call, write down the one outcome you want and the one question that gets you there.
